The drawing shows two nitrogen atoms joined by a two-carbon (ethylene) bridge. Each nitrogen carries two CH2–COOH arms, so there are four carboxymethyl groups in total. This is ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA). No wedges, hashes or double-bond geometry are drawn, so the SMILES has no stereochemistry.

SMILES: OC(=O)CN(CC(=O)O)CCN(CC(=O)O)CC(=O)O
